t: Time 3182Y white flexible cable provides robust connectivity for power tools and medium-load appliances requiring no earth connection. This 25m drum features 27 x strands per core delivering reliable flexibility for repeated movement and handling during work, with brown and blue colour-coded insulation for safe polarity identification. The 1.5mm² conductors rated 300/500V enable higher power delivery than lighter gauges, whilst the -15 to 70°C operating range ensures consistent performance across typical domestic workshop and kitchen environments.
b: Suitable for Power Tools & Medium Appliances Requiring No Earth
